headlines.summary: easyJet cabin crew in Portugal voted on Thursday to stage strikes from 2 to 6 October and 19 to 23 December over working conditions and pay.

headlines.title: What to expect from the Trump-Xi summit, from tariffs to a possible $30 billion deal
headlines.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to hold talks with US President Donald Trump in Washington next week, with an expiring trade truce, tens of billions in tariff relief and AI all on the table as both economies need the relationship to hold.

headlines.title: Global Gender Gap Report: Women s hard-won gains fragile
headlines.summary: Two decades of progress toward gender parity is at risk as women s political representation declines, according to a new World Economic Forum report. At the current pace, the remaining gap could take 120 years to close.

headlines.summary: O'Leary described his choice of language as "careless" and said "it won't happen again".

headlines.title: A new wave of listings: Tashkent prepares companies for global markets
headlines.summary: Uzbekistan’s investment fund (UzNIF) is preparing major companies in telecoms, aviation, banking and energy for potential listings. Uztelecom is currently the most advanced candidate as governance reforms advance and efforts to attract new capital gather pace.

headlines.summary: NATO's Adm. Giuseppe Cavo Dragone's remarks follow multiple warnings by European leaders in recent days about a growing risk of Russian escalation.

headlines.title: Revolut weighs dual listing in New York and London for its long-awaited IPO
headlines.summary: Revolut is considering listing simultaneously in New York and London when it eventually goes public, its founder has stated, a plan that would keep the fintech partly at home while giving it access to the deeper American market it has long preferred.

headlines.summary: Russia has placed the local businesses of Nestlé, Auchan and other Western-linked companies under temporary administration. Nestlé is weighing its options, while Auchan and Lemana Pro say their Russian operations continue as normal.

trend_headline: 중동 발유가 급등과 독일 연료세 인하
summary: 중동발 지정학적 리스크로 유가가 치솟자 독일 정부가 연료세를 전격 인하하고 정유사 횡재세 도입을 검토하며 에너지 비용 압박에 대응하고 있습니다. JP모건은 트럼프의 대이란 정책으로 유가 전망 예측이 극도로 난항을 겪고 있다고 경고했습니다.
key_points: 중동 분쟁 심화로 JP모건은 트럼프 행정부의 대이란 정책 속 유가 100달러 돌파 가능성 등 정확한 원유 가격 예측에 난항
독일은 치솟는 에너지 가격과 물가 안정을 위해 연료세를 인하하고 EU 차원의 정유사 횡재세(windfall tax) 도입 촉구
라인메탈 CEO는 독일의 미사일 재고가 우려스러울 정도로 낮다며 방산 물자 생산의 가속화 필요성 강조
